statements.status_notes: The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream xmllint interactive shell memory-leak fix from https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/160c8a43ba37dfb07ebe6446fbad9d0973d9279d as dhi-cve-2026-1757-shell-cmdline-leak.patch. Upstream fixes this in shell.c (>= 2.14); on the 2.13.9 source the interactive shell loop still lives in debugXML.c as xmlShell(), and the patch frees cmdline before continuing on whitespace-only input. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-1757

The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream xmlcatalog --shell overflow fix from https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/c2e233fc1b341685fc99621b2768b503f777a72e as dhi-cve-2026-11979-xmlcatalog-shell-overflow.patch, which bounds the fixed-size command, arg and argv stack buffers in usershell(). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-11979
